$comment: Pack-authored overlay: the choice points buried inside SRD species traits. The SRD writes these as prose ('Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table'); a builder needs them as options. Merged into species.json by tools/build_origins_data.py — a re-import never clobbers this file. Origins grants the level 1 benefit only, so the level 3/5 rows of the lineage tables are deliberately absent. 'from' draws options from reference.json/feats.json instead of listing them here.

dragonborn.label: Draconic ancestry
dragonborn.help: Sets the damage type of your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance.

options.name: Drow
options.note: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet. You also know the Dancing Lights cantrip.

options.name: High Elf
options.note: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

options.name: Wood Elf
options.note: Your Speed increases to 35 feet. You also know the Druidcraft cantrip.

options.name: Forest Gnome
options.note: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared.

options.name: Rock Gnome
options.note: You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips, and can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device.

options.name: Abyssal
options.note: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also know the Poison Spray cantrip.

options.name: Chthonic
options.note: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage. You also know the Chill Touch cantrip.

options.name: Infernal
options.note: You have Resistance to Fire damage. You also know the Fire Bolt cantrip.
